Neural Network Topology Optimization with Adam Optimizer

Description

This tutorial demonstrates neural network-parametrized topology optimization using Flux.jl’s Adam optimizer. Unlike the IPOPT-based approach, this method uses first-order gradient descent with adaptive learning rates. A continuation strategy progressively increases the SIMP penalty (1→5) and constraint aggregation weight (0.1→100) to converge to binary designs.

The network uses 6 hidden layers (deeper than the IPOPT example) with softmax output for material fraction parametrization.

Setup

using TopOpt, Zygote, Flux
using NNlib: leakyrelu

Problem Definition

E = 1.0 # Young's modulus
v = 0.3 # Poisson's ratio
f = 1.0 # downward force
els = (160, 40)

problem = PointLoadCantilever(Val{:Linear}, els, (1.0, 1.0), E, v, f)

V = 0.5       # volume fraction
xmin = 1e-6   # minimum density
rmin = 3.0    # filter radius

# Continuation parameters
p = 1.0           # initial SIMP penalty
delta_p = 0.01    # penalty increment per epoch
p_max = 5.0       # maximum penalty

alpha = 0.1       # initial constraint weight
delta_alpha = 0.05
alpha_max = 100   # maximum constraint weight

# Initial solver and compliance for C0
penalty = TopOpt.PowerPenalty(p)
solver = FEASolver(DirectSolver, problem; xmin, penalty)
cheqfilter = DensityFilter(solver; rmin)
comp = Compliance(solver)
C0 = comp(cheqfilter(PseudoDensities(fill(V, TopOpt.getncells(problem)))))

Neural Network

# 6-layer MLP with softmax output
m = 20
act = leakyrelu
nn = NeuralNetwork(
    Chain(
        Dense(2, m, act; init=Flux.glorot_normal),
        Dense(m, m, act; init=Flux.glorot_normal),
        Dense(m, m, act; init=Flux.glorot_normal),
        Dense(m, m, act; init=Flux.glorot_normal),
        Dense(m, m, act; init=Flux.glorot_normal),
        Dense(m, m, act; init=Flux.glorot_normal),
        softmax,
        x -> [x[1]],
    ),
    problem;
    scale=true,
)
w0 = nn.init_params

Optimizer Setup

alg = Flux.Optimise.Adam(0.1)
clip_alg = Flux.Optimise.ClipValue(1.0)
w = copy(w0)

# Heaviside projection for binary designs
proj = HeavisideProjection(0.0)

# Termination criteria
eps = Inf
eps_star = 0.05    # target binary fraction
maxiter = 20
constr_tol = 0.01

Density Functions

function todensities(w; filter=true)
    if filter
        PseudoDensities(proj.(cheqfilter(nn(NNParams(w))).x))
    else
        PseudoDensities(proj.(nn(NNParams(w)).x))
    end
end

Optimization Loop

epoch = 1
while true
    epoch > maxiter && break
    eps < eps_star && break
    
    # Update penalty and constraint weight
    global p = min(p + delta_p, p_max)
    global alpha = min(alpha + delta_alpha, alpha_max)
    
    # Rebuild solver with current penalty
    global penalty = TopOpt.PowerPenalty(p)
    global solver = FEASolver(DirectSolver, problem; xmin, penalty)
    global cheqfilter = DensityFilter(solver; rmin)
    global comp = Compliance(solver)
    global volfrac = Volume(solver)
    
    obj = w -> comp(todensities(w; filter=true)) / C0
    constr = w -> volfrac(todensities(w; filter=false)) / V - 1
    combined_obj = w -> obj(w) + alpha * constr(w)^2
    
    # Adam step
    Δ = Zygote.gradient(combined_obj, w)[1]
    Flux.Optimise.update!(alg, w, Δ)
    
    # Check convergence
    x = nn(NNParams(w)).x
    eps = sum(0.05 .< x .< 0.95) / length(x)
    violation = abs(constr(w))
    
    println("Epoch $epoch: p=$p, α=$alpha, obj=$(obj(w)), constr=$(constr(w)), eps=$eps")
    epoch += 1
end
